name: transcribe
description: Transcribe audio or video to SRT and word-level JSON using whisper.cpp

input.description: Video or audio file to transcribe

output.description: JSON object with paths to both outputs: {"srt": "...", "words": "..."}, plus word_count, speech_s (first word start to last word end) and wpm (words per minute over that span, one decimal). The three are left out if the words file cannot be read.

params.name: model
params.description: Whisper model. Larger = slower + more accurate. English-only (*.en) models are auto-upgraded to a multilingual sibling when language is non-English.

params.name: language
params.description: Language code (e.g. en, fr, de, es), or 'auto' for whisper-cli language auto-detection. A non-English value upgrades an *.en model to its multilingual sibling.

params.name: max-context
params.description: Cap on prior-text tokens carried between windows (whisper.cpp -mc). Set 0 to disable cross-window context — the reliable fix for the repetition-loop hallucination on long audio (especially non-English). Omit for the whisper default.

params.name: whole-file
params.description: Transcribe the whole file in one pass. By default each run of voice is its own clip, all of a take's clips in one whisper call, so retakes said back to back are all heard and times do not drift. A trim spec always goes whole, and so does a file with no voiced run. max-context is ignored by runs.

params.name: fit-pauses
params.description: For captions: fit word times to the pauses measured in the audio, so a word after a pause starts on the voice. Leave it off for anything that cuts on word times.
